overview.description: The Canary Litecoin ETF (LTCC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long ltc, short usd currency. The fund is passively managed, seeking the price performance of spot Litecoin (LTC) by holding it directly, secured through a cold storage wallet. An investment in the fund is not a direct investment in LTC. LTCC was launched on Oct 28, 2025 and is issued by Canary.
